findings.claim: The requirement says MessagePack attributes on T must be honoured, but they are ignored. In contractless mode the collector never reads T's attributes: CreateContractlessMembers takes every public read-write member, sorts it by name and gives it a string key. For a metadata type with [MessagePackObject], [Key(0)] Id and [IgnoreMember] Secret, the generated formatter writes a string-keyed map with 'Id' and also serializes 'Secret', which T explicitly excluded. The wire format also differs from T's own formatter.

receipt_plan.detail: Run Receipts.GeneratedTests.GeneratedFormatterLogicReceiptsTests.AttributesOnFormattedTypeAreHonoured. ProjectA.MyType (emitted to metadata) has [MessagePackObject], [Key(0)] Id and [IgnoreMember] Secret. The generated MyTypeFormatter source contains 'Secret' on head.

findings.claim: In surrogate mode every instance field or property of the surrogate, including private ones, must carry [Key] or [IgnoreMember]. Otherwise MemberNeedsKey is reported and no formatter is generated. A normal [MessagePackObject] surrogate with a private helper field is therefore rejected, although the regular analyzer only requires keys on public members (L5).

receipt_plan.detail: Run GeneratedFormatterLogicReceiptsTests.SurrogateWithPrivateFieldIsAccepted. The generator run result contains a MemberNeedsKey diagnostic for the private field 'cache'.

findings.claim: A surrogate declared [MessagePackObject(true)] (keyAsPropertyName, L3) needs no [Key] attributes. The surrogate collector still demands a Key on every member, so it reports MemberNeedsKey and generates nothing. The keyAsPropertyName argument is never read, which contradicts the documented 'every MessagePack attribute on the surrogate is honoured'.

receipt_plan.detail: Run GeneratedFormatterLogicReceiptsTests.KeyAsPropertyNameSurrogateIsAccepted. The run result has a MemberNeedsKey diagnostic on head.

findings.claim: Generated formatter models are added to the same model set whose output is gated by Options.IsGeneratingSource. If the project declares no [GeneratedMessagePackResolver] class, the user's body-less 'partial class X : IMessagePackFormatter<T>' appears to get no implementation and fails with CS0535. The requirement's example declares only the formatter.

receipt_plan.detail: Run GeneratedFormatterLogicReceiptsTests.FormatterIsGeneratedWithoutResolverDeclaration. No generated tree contains 'class MyTypeFormatter' when no resolver is declared.

findings.claim: If T is declared in the same compilation with [MessagePackObject] and also targeted by [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter], both the regular collector and GeneratedFormatterCollector add an ObjectSerializationInfo for the same data type. The resolver then registers two formatters for one type. Nothing de-duplicates them and no diagnostic is reported.

receipt_plan.detail: MessagePackGenerator.cs:70-76 adds generatedModel without checking whether modelPerType already holds an ObjectInfo for the same DataType. The regular path at lines 60-68 collects the [MessagePackObject] type independently.

findings.claim: If SurrogateType names a type that is not an INamedTypeSymbol (for example typeof(int[])), the transform's 'as INamedTypeSymbol' yields null. The formatter then silently falls back to contractless mode instead of reporting an invalid surrogate.

receipt_plan.detail: MessagePackGenerator.cs:34 casts NamedArguments[SurrogateType].Value with 'as INamedTypeSymbol'. A null surrogate goes to CreateContractlessMembers (GeneratedFormatterCollector.cs:89-93) with no diagnostic.

questions.text: Must a [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] class get its implementation even when the project declares no [GeneratedMessagePackResolver] class?
options: Yes, the formatter must be generated standalone, as in the requirement's example
No, a [GeneratedMessagePackResolver] declaration is a documented prerequisite
questions.why_it_matters: If yes, gating generated formatters on IsGeneratingSource is a high-severity defect: a body-less formatter fails to compile. If no, the behaviour is intended, but it needs a diagnostic or documentation instead of a CS0535 error.
